body.t: Load coordinate rows to display zoom-dependent point clusters with counts. Zoom in to split a cluster into smaller groups and individual points. This is a map-display grouping, not a statistical clustering algorithm or a claim that points share a real-world cause.

Put three nearby coordinates in a CSV and one coordinate far away. At a broad zoom the nearby points may share a count bubble; zooming closer should separate them. The original four rows remain four points in a GeoJSON export.
